roleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services
jobDescription: The maintenance services division of an industrial equipment supplier collects sensor and service-visit data from customer machines. The Data Analytics Engineer builds the pipelines that combine telemetry with work-order history, maintains the failure-prediction features used by the planning team, and is expected to demonstrate a measurable increase in the share of failures caught before an unplanned stop, against the division's published baseline.
requirements: Builds and maintains pipelines that join machine telemetry with work-order history in the analytics warehouse.
Maintains the failure-prediction feature set used by the maintenance planning team.
Demonstrates a measurable increase in failures caught before an unplanned stop, against the published baseline.
Coordinates schema and feature changes with the planning and platform teams and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents data lineage, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each pipeline release.

evidence.text: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.
Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.
Responsibilities included pipeline development, feature maintenance, data-review coordination and lineage documentation for the maintenance analytics warehouse over about two years.
Work sample: the feature-set change log for one quarter and the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, with the Databricks job identifiers as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said the planning team told him the model 'now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half'; he said the numbers were the planning team's, that he had not seen the evaluation, and that several other changes were made to the model in the same period.

Hiring manager pre-read: the division head is looking for an engineer who has already improved early-catch rates; the packet should say exactly which improvements are documented and attributable to the candidate.

propositions.text: The candidate built the hourly pipeline that joins machine telemetry with work-order history in the analytics warehouse, including late-arrival handling.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the pipeline and its late-arrival rule directly.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained and versioned the failure-prediction feature set consumed by the planning team's model.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change log document the feature maintenance.

propositions.text: The candidate's feature work raised the share of failures caught early from half to two thirds.
propositions.rationale: The figures are second-hand from the planning team, the candidate has not seen the evaluation, and other model changes were made in the same period; no evaluation is in the materials.

gold.expectedGap: No evaluation in the materials measures the early-catch rate before and after the candidate's feature changes, and concurrent model changes are acknowledged.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Do not attribute the planning team's recollected early-catch figures to the candidate; the materials document the pipeline and feature work, not a measured effect.
followUpTargets: Ask for the planning team's model evaluation with the metric definition, baseline period and the list of changes made in the same period.
